buyAttentionFlow: New guided buyer flow (BuyAttention dialog): kind of attention from the placement categories, where-or-when via featured events or a UTC date, budget steps

Matches only real bookable placements from discovery; example cards (sample), test fixtures (sponsorship_test_*, integration_*), services, closed/ended/full offers excluded by src/lib/buy-attention.ts
Picking a match opens the existing booking dialog with the brief prefilled from the answers; escrow semantics, terms immutability and funding path unchanged
Signed out the whole flow; the booking step keeps its existing Sign in to book gate
No dead ends: same-kind matches when timing/budget miss, nearest category chips with live counts, browse link otherwise
Entry points: hero primary button and a BUY ATTENTION nav item
listingAgentChat: Answered quick-pick dropdowns collapse into low-key chips (value + change) between the chat log and the answer box; change reopens only that dropdown with its current value

Speed for impatient users: typed plain prices and plain name answers apply instantly with zero assistant round trips; assistant history trimmed to the last 12 messages; the AI path is unchanged for everything else
